title: Templated hotfix adjudication and safe rollback workflow
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: Create a lightweight, repeatable adjudication and rollback workflow for critical fixes that balances speed with safety. Scope covers severity thresholds, decision authority, patch branch strategy, backport rules across LTS channels, rollout gates, automated gating checks, and communication templates.

Key deliverables:
- Severity matrix (S0,S1,S2,S3) with concrete examples and SLA for decision window and remediation window.
- Hotfix adjudication template: who signs (on-call, release lead, PM, engineering manager), required evidence (repro, metrics, user impact), and mandatory checks before cut.
- Branching conventions: "hotfix/<version>/short-desc" for immediate patches; automated branch creation for backport candidates; tagging policy for LTS vs mainline.
- Backport rules: mandatory for LTS-1 and LTS-2 for S0/S1; optional for S2 with triage; S3 deferred to next minor. Backport priority queue + owner.
- Rollout gates: automated canary phase (5% 30m -> 25% 60m -> 100% 2h) with health checks (error rate, p50/p95 latency, backend queue depth, cost-upticks).
- Rollback criteria: explicit thresholds per metric, automated rollback trigger, and manual override with audit log.
- Automation: GitHub Actions workflow for cut/release backport PRs, CI checks to ensure changelog entries and migration safety, and a one-click rollback in the release controller.
- Communication: PR templates, Slack incident channel + pinned template messages, user-facing status page copy.
- Post-release requirements: 24h monitoring window, follow-up postmortem for S0/S1, and a runbook update if the fix deviated from the template.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement the runtime rollback mechanism itself (separate runtime task) nor the enterprise approval UI for Private customers.

Success criteria:
- Playbook documented in Confluence and approved by release leads and PMs.
- Automation produces a hotfix candidate branch and backport PRs with required checks in <= 10 minutes from decision.
- Rollouts use the defined gates by default and support manual override with recorded rationale.
